summary: Pop Culture Group Co., Ltd filed a Form 424B5 prospectus supplement for a registered direct offering of 7,448,000 Class A ordinary shares at $0.15 per share and 45,885,333 pre-funded warrants, each with a purchase price of $0.15 minus a $0.01 exercise price. The offering is to institutional investors; no board recommendation or advisors are specified. Proceeds go to the company; the shares are listed on Nasdaq under CPOP. This is a routine capital-raising registration, not an event-driven corporate action. No special-situation triggers are present.
